record.reference_lean_code:
import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_i_telescope (f : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f (i + 1) - f i)) = f n - f 0 := by
  induction n with | zero => simp | succ n ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; ring
